claim: A Mercury period traditionally emphasises learning, communication, commerce and intellectual work.

source_name: Traditional gochara (transit) rules, paraphrased

claim: Jupiter transiting the 2nd, 5th, 7th, 9th or 11th from the natal Moon is traditionally considered favourable.
